content.short: A privacy-focused, cross-platform Ethereum wallet for desktop designed for power users and Web3 native experiences.
content.description:
Frame is a lightweight, privacy-oriented Ethereum wallet providing a secure interface for decentralized applications. As a native desktop app, it manages keys locally while routing Web3 requests from browsers. Frame's focus on user control ensures interactions are secure and private, minimizing the exposure of sensitive data to web-based extensions.

Supporting multiple EVM chains, Frame offers a unified experience with hardware wallet integration. It is a vital tool for those seeking a more secure way to manage digital assets without compromising on speed or ease of use.
content.meta: Experience secure, privacy-focused Web3 on your desktop with Frame. Manage your digital assets and NFTs across various EVM networks.
